description: On the table in front of you are four small plastic plates: yellow on the left, red near the middle-right, a green plate near the front-right, and a blue plate on the far right. The right hand slides the blue plate into position, then lifts the green plate and places it on top of the red plate; next, the right hand moves the blue plate over to stack with the others and finally slides the yellow plate onto the top, forming a neat stack while the hand releases.
